ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced animal bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Specialized veterinary implants go beyond replacement anatomy to provide animals with new abilities and forms of control.
Manufacture an animal mind controller implant. This implant will allow this creature to be drafted and controlled by the player. Counts as a prosthetic when considering animal body size to be installed.
